verdict.rationale: Sentry provides official SDKs across languages/platforms via simple drop-in installation (sentry-docs-12, sentry-docs-29, sentry-docs-16) and even AI-agent-specific tracing SDK support for catching bad tool calls and visualizing agent spend/performance (sentry-docs-13), directly serving AI-native builders instrumenting agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or agent-tracing SDK usage, and no explicit AI-native SDK-specific tutorial beyond marketing copy.
